source: How fast each figure actually moves. Balances change every pay cycle and every purchase; income and spending change on the order of a job change or a lease renewal; a date of birth never does.
confidenceNote: These are review intervals, not measurements. Past the interval a figure is shown in amber and offered for a quick re-confirm; it is never silently distrusted, discounted or zeroed.
note: staleAfterDays is per ownership field id (shared/ownership.js). null means the figure does not go stale. `volatile` is the short list the Refresh page walks — the ones worth re-checking monthly, in the order they are asked.
